title: Scholarships: government
summary: Central Sector SC/ST, Minority, Single Girl Child, AP Pratibha, INSPIRE, National Scholarship Portal.

posts.md:
The Central and State Governments offer various scholarships for eligible IIT Madras students. These scholarships have specific eligibility criteria, income limits, and renewal conditions.

## Central Sector Scholarship for SC Students

**Eligibility**

* SC students
* Top **10** based on **JEE Rank**
* Parents' annual income **≤ ₹4.5 lakh**
* Applicable to **B.Tech, Dual Degree & MBA** students

**Benefits**

* ₹45,000 (One-time PC Grant)
* ₹2,200/month Living Expenses
* ₹3,000/year Books & Stationery
* Reimbursement of Tuition & Other Eligible Fees

## Central Sector Scholarship for ST Students

**Eligibility**

* ST students
* Top **5** based on **JEE Rank**
* Parents' annual income **≤ ₹6 lakh**
* Applicable to **B.Tech, Dual Degree & MBA** students
* Renewable subject to passing the final examination each year

**Benefits**

* ₹45,000 (One-time PC Grant)
* ₹2,200/month Living Expenses
* ₹3,000/year Books & Stationery
* Reimbursement of Tuition & Other Eligible Fees

## Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (Minority Affairs)

**Eligibility**

* Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist & Parsi students
* Parents' annual income **≤ ₹2.5 lakh**

**Benefits**

* ₹10,000/year (Hostellers)
* ₹5,000/year (Day Scholars)
* Course Fee Reimbursement up to **₹20,000** (or actual fee, whichever is lower)
* 30% scholarships reserved for girl students
* Renewable subject to passing the final examination each year

## MHRD Scholarship for Single Girl Child

**Eligibility**

* As per Government of India norms

**Benefits**

* ₹40,000/year

## Pratibha Scholarship (Government of Andhra Pradesh)

**Eligibility**

* B.Tech students who are natives of Andhra Pradesh
* Minimum **60% (First Class)** in Class XII/Intermediate
* Parents' annual income **≤ ₹1 lakh**

**Benefits**

* ₹20,000/year (Renewable)
* Apply directly through the Andhra Pradesh Government

## INSPIRE Scholarship (DST, Government of India)

**Eligibility**

* Students admitted to the **Dual Degree (B.S. & M.S.)** programme

**Benefits**

* ₹80,000/year for **5 years**

## National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

The **National Scholarship Portal (NSP)** is the Government of India's single portal for applying to Central and State Government scholarships.

**Website:** https://scholarships.gov.in/

**Common Documents**

* Aadhaar Card
* Income Certificate
* Category Certificate (if applicable)
* Bonafide Certificate
* Previous Mark Sheets
* Bank Account Details
* Passport-size Photograph

**Need Help?**
Visit the **Scholarship Section, 4th Floor, Administration Block, IIT Madras**.

### Important Notes

* Check the eligibility criteria before applying.
* Submit applications before the deadline.
* Most scholarships require satisfactory academic performance for renewal.
* Applications may be submitted through **NSP** or the respective State Government portal, depending on the scheme.
